roster.authority: May file photos on its own under the identity standard: 2 anchors = confirmed, 1 anchor = possible (Confirm/Reject).
roster.mission: Own photo coverage — recruit hunter experts, keep finding new search routes, never accept that everything has been tried.
roster.name: Photos Director
roster.status: Standing up — first weekly cycle pending.

subs.authority: May hide a bad photo. May never delete one.
subs.mission: Verify every photo on file is the right person, properly framed and aligned (1:1, face not clipped), and displaying.
subs.name: Photo QC Expert

roster.authority: May fix pure presentation bugs directly (contrast, overlap, dead control). Layout and behavior changes go to JD first.
roster.mission: Walk the app as JD in both themes: every button works, all text readable, navigation simple, no overlaps or layout flaws.
roster.name: UX Director
roster.status: Standing up — first weekly cycle pending.

roster.authority: Flags and stages only. Merges and meaning changes are never executed without JD's ruling.
roster.mission: Runs last. Audit the universe for sense: duplicates, possible matches, missed connections, re-sort ideas, near-duplicate orgs and groups.
roster.name: Content Director
roster.status: Standing up — first weekly cycle pending.

roster.authority: No director starts a large run without Resource clearance. Extensions come only from actual headroom.
roster.mission: Own the token budget: read the gauge against pace, authorize extra work from real headroom, call a halt when the day's tranche is spent.
roster.name: Resource Manager

roster.authority: Can stop a spinning worker and re-task it. Tripwires: 3 attempts on one route with no new evidence; a run with no state change in its window.
roster.mission: Own traction: catch spinning tires — repeated routes, stalls, work with no new evidence — and force a different approach.
roster.name: Progress Auditor
roster.status: Standing up — rides along on every council run.

roster.authority: Final authority below JD. Directors never report to JD separately.
roster.mission: Everyone reports here. Schedule runs, deconflict file access, enforce budget and tripwires, deliver one consolidated roll-up.
roster.name: Director of Operations
